book_title: Prologue: The Afcom Refresh Verdict — H1 Cash Inflection Collides With Liquidity, Governance & Stage 3 Breakdown
question: After Afcom's 10% drop to ₹1,367.85 live (₹1,374.90 on the 2026-11-23 ledger) and Pass 1's liquidity, fleet-lag, and governance discoveries, should you add capital or exit your 120 Zerodha shares ahead of the November 30 call?

epigraph.quote: Good cash-flow progress cannot rescue a Stage 3 breakdown when unrestricted cash is thin and founders are heading for the exit.
epigraph.author: Institutional Underwriting Charter

web_blocks.html: Afcom Holdings (BSE: 544224) closed at **₹1,374.90** on the `2026-11-23` NSE/BSE ledger and **₹1,367.85** live on `2026-11-25` (₹3,977.40 crore market cap) [1, 3]. Revenue scaled fast after its December 2024 AOC, jumping from ₹148.19 crore in FY24 to ₹583.00 crore in FY26 and ₹417.00 crore in H1 FY27 at 38.4%–40.0% EBITDA margins [1, 9, 20]. Our Pass 1 audit found one clear positive. H1 FY27 operating cash flow rose to **₹49.47 crore** (55.0% of ₹90.00 crore PAT vs. 29.5% in FY26) as trade receivables stabilized at ₹134.52 crore [28]. Yet Pass 1 also uncovered four serious drags that keep quality **CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL** (`PASS_WITH_WATCH`). H1 free cash flow ran **-₹164.99 crore**, leaving just **₹5.15 crore** in unrestricted cash outside ₹87.16 crore of restricted QIP funds [28]. Zero QIP funds went to customs or aircraft insurance by September 30, proving 4th/5th aircraft induction lag [28]. Meanwhile, co-founder Wg. Cdr. Jaganmohan Manthena resigned on November 12, promoter-group sales continued, and IndiGo CarGo already flies three 27-tonne A321P2F freighters [27, 29, 31, 33].

web_blocks.html: Our **Dual Verdict** reflects both Pass 1 forensics and the chart breakdown. For **new capital**, Afcom stays strictly **REJECTED** (`TIER_0`, `TREND, CASH_FLOW, VALUATION`). Both `facts_IN_2026-11-23.json` (`₹1,374.90`) and live TradingView (`2026-11-25`, `₹1,367.85`) confirm **STAGE_3**. Price sits -2.51% below the 10-week EMA (₹1,403.01) and -3.49% below the falling 50-day SMA (₹1,417.26). Distribution days rose to 6, 63-day RS fell to -15.79%, and 4H RSI sits at 42.72 with no turn. Separating `30.9%` pre-lease CFO/EBITDA from `55.0%` CFO/PAT cuts post-lease Base fair value to **₹1,250.00** (`-8.6%` vs. live; `< 0:1` CMP R:R).

Zerodha holds **120 AFCOM shares** at a ₹1,620.00 average cost (₹1,94,400.00 basis). That stake is worth ₹1,64,988.00 (-15.13%, 3.87% NAV) on the 2026-11-23 ledger and ₹1,64,142.00 (-15.56%) at live ₹1,367.85. With Red Team EV at **₹1,130.00** (-17.4%) and unhedgeable Nov 30 gap risk (`NOT_OPTIONABLE_OR_ILLIQUID`, ~41k daily shares), we tighten `holding_action` to **EXIT_IMMEDIATELY** (`holding_shares_to_sell: 120`). Sell **60 shares on Day 1** and **60 shares across Days 2–3 before Nov 30**, freeing `~₹1.64L` and keeping our locked **₹1,256.71** stop as an immediate circuit breaker.

We redeploy `~₹1.64L` freed from AFCOM alongside Zerodha's ₹14,20,949.94 cash reserve (33.32% NAV). Nifty 50 (25,349.65 on 2026-11-23) sits in a narrow-breadth uptrend with only 48.2% of Nifty 500 stocks above their 200-DMA and India VIX at 17.70. We keep **60% in `CASH`**. We deploy **40% into Stage 2 shortlist leader `ZYDUSLIFE`** (₹1,236.00 live / ₹1,199.50 ledger; `ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP`, 2.03:1 asymmetry toward ₹1,420.00). We hold **0% in extended `INDIGO`** (₹5,720.00 live, `CAP_WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT`) until it pulls back into ₹5,190–₹5,461.

web_blocks.title: How This Refreshed Dossier Is Structured
paragraphs: Chapters 1–6 were audited price-blind in Pass 1. They fix balance-sheet scaling errors, add H1 FY27 liquidity forensics, track co-founder Manthena's Nov 12 exit, and add IndiGo CarGo's 3 A321P2F freighters. Chapters 7–9 re-price post-lease Reverse DCF at ₹1,367.85 live / ₹1,374.90 ledger, verify Stage 3, lock the ₹1,256.71 floor, and detail our full 120-share EXIT_IMMEDIATELY plan.

book_paragraphs: Welcome to our refreshed institutional underwriting dossier on Afcom Holdings Limited, ticker AFCOM on the Bombay Stock Exchange, anchored to the November 23, 2026 NSE/BSE ledger close of ₹1,374.90 and the live November 25, 2026 TradingView close of ₹1,367.85. Two weeks after our initial underwriting, both the fundamental evidence and the price tape have shifted sharply—requiring an honest, unhedged update.

In our verdict-stripped Pass 1 audit of Chapters 1 through 6, we uncovered one genuinely encouraging improvement alongside four serious red flags. On the positive side, H1 FY27 operating cash flow rose to ₹49.47 crore—55 percent of net profit versus 29.5 percent in FY26—as trade receivables stabilized at ₹134.52 crore on ₹417 crore of half-year revenue. Yet beneath that headline improvement, actual pre-lease CFO-to-EBITDA was only 30.9 percent before Ind AS 116 lease principal outflows, and H1 free cash flow ran negative ₹164.99 crore—leaving just ₹5.15 crore of unrestricted operating cash outside ₹87.16 crore of restricted QIP monitoring funds.

At the same time, zero QIP rupees had been deployed toward aircraft customs or insurance by September 30—proving fourth-and-fifth narrowbody induction lag—while co-founder Jaganmohan Manthena resigned from the Board and Audit Committee on November 12, promoter-group open-market disposals continued through November 25, and our competitive audit revealed that IndiGo CarGo already flies three dedicated 27-tonne A321P2F freighters. Afcom therefore remains CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL with a PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI status.

book_subsections.title: The Dual Verdict: REJECTED for New Capital, Full EXIT_IMMEDIATELY on 120 Zerodha Shares
paragraphs: When we open the price screen in Chapters 7 and 8, both our November 23 ledger and live November 25 TradingView snapshot confirm Stage 3: Topping and Pullback, with price below both the 10-week EMA and falling 50-day moving average, six distribution days in twenty-five sessions, and minus 15.79 percent relative strength against the Nifty 50. Modeling actual post-lease cash economics honestly lowers our Reverse DCF Base Case fair value to ₹1,250—8.6 percent below live ₹1,367.85—and yields a Red Team stress-test expected value of ₹1,130, or minus 17.4 percent.

Accordingly, new capital remains strictly REJECTED at TIER_0 on TREND, CASH_FLOW, and VALUATION. For your existing 120 Zerodha shares—bought at ₹1,620 and now down roughly 15.1 to 15.6 percent at 3.87 percent of your ₹42.64 lakh account—we tighten holding action all the way to EXIT_IMMEDIATELY: sell all 120 shares cleanly across two to three sessions ahead of the unhedgeable November 30 investor call, keeping ₹1,256.71 as an immediate execution floor, and redeploy freed cash alongside your ₹14.21 lakh cash buffer into 60 percent cash and 40 percent Stage 2 shortlist leader Zydus Lifesciences.

callouts.title: NARRATOR'S REFLECTION
callouts.quote: A refresh only earns its keep when it catches what the first pass missed—and exits cleanly before an unhedgeable investor call turns a fifteen-percent loss into a deeper drawdown.
callouts.text: Let us walk through Chapters 1 to 9 with complete transparency: the operational rise, the corrected balance sheet, the governance and competitive blind spots, the post-lease ₹1,250 Reverse DCF, and your exact full exit plan.

book_subsections.title: Four Checkpoints Governing the November 30 Call and Beyond
paragraphs: As you listen through Chapters 1 to 9, keep four concrete checkpoints anchored in your mind. First, unrestricted operating cash must rebuild meaningfully from September 30's razor-thin ₹5.15 crore level without starving trade payables further. Second, management must disclose firm, verifiable Q4 FY27 customs and insurance clearance milestones for the fourth and fifth Boeing 737-800BCF narrowbodies so that right-of-use assets resume growing rather than shrinking.

Third, governance clarity is non-negotiable: investors need a candid explanation of co-founder Jaganmohan Manthena's November 12 departure from the Board and Audit Committee alongside an end to promoter-group open-market share sales. Fourth, Afcom must defend its ASEAN scheduled and charter yields as IndiGo CarGo scales its three dedicated 27-tonne A321P2F freighters. Every figure in this refreshed monograph ties directly to audited BSE filings, the November 23, 2026 NSE/BSE ledger, and the live November 25, 2026 TradingView snapshot.

Pay close attention to how our portfolio architecture reinforces this discipline. Across your ₹42.64 lakh Zerodha account, holding 33.32 percent cash gives you genuine optionality in a narrow-breadth market where fewer than half of Nifty 500 stocks trade above their 200-day moving average. Exiting all 120 shares of Afcom ahead of November 30 eliminates unhedgeable single-stock event risk completely, preserves roughly ₹1.64 lakh for higher-asymmetry Stage 2 opportunities like Zydus Lifesciences, and ensures a single cargo airline can never derail portfolio compounding.

Equally important, notice how this refreshed dossier separates verified facts from narrative hype. Every single balance-sheet line in Chapters 3 and 6 has been reconciled against Afcom's audited FY26 and standalone H1 FY27 BSE filings, correcting earlier unit-scaling misstatements and separating ₹87.16 crore of restricted QIP monitoring funds from ₹5.15 crore of unrestricted operating cash. By locking our ₹1,256.71 hard stop strictly upward-only during execution and refusing to hold a negative-expected-value Stage 3 chart into a binary call, we let evidence—not sunk cost—govern every rupee in your Zerodha account. Let us begin with Chapter 1.
